releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.2.0 — Automated Low-Level Game-Focus Mode (Zero-Kill Background Governor):
- Game-Focus Mode: Automatically elevates focused 3D games to HIGH_PRIORITY_CLASS across all CPU cores while dynamically shifting non-essential background applications (Chrome, Discord, Spotify, Steam, OneDrive) to secondary/efficiency cores (Cores 10-11) at BELOW_NORMAL priority.
- Zero Data Loss / Zero App Termination: Background apps continue running smoothly (music keeps playing, voice calls stay connected) without competing with the game's render loop.
- Non-Intrusive UXTU / Undervolt Interop Layer.
- Zero-Dependency Native Architecture (<15 MB RAM, <0.1% CPU).
- OEM Bloatware & Telemetry Neutralizer.
- DirectX 11/12 Driver Pipeline Command List Multi-Threading Optimizer.
- SMT Core Parking on Battery (CPMINCORES 50, -18% Package Power).
- Micro-Thread Priority Gating for Anti-Cheat & DRM.
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass (DirectFlip & Flip Queue = 1).
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing).
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
